vehicle.tab.label: Vehicles
vehicle.tab.title: Vehicle heatmap: the hits on one vehicle type, painted on its figure
vehicle.panel.title: Vehicle heatmap
vehicle.empty.title: Vehicle heatmap
vehicle.empty.noData: Load a match with hits on vehicles - a War Thunder, World of Tanks or World of Warships replay converted by its converter, or a CS2 demo table. Drop the files here or use the source panel.
vehicle.empty.noHits: The loaded data has no hits with a place on a vehicle. Convert the replay again with the current converter: War Thunder and World of Warships write hitLocalX/Y/Z, World of Tanks hitComponent and hitU/V/W, CS2 hitgroup and hitLocalX/Y/Z.
vehicle.hint.unplaced: {n, plural, one {# hit has} other {# hits have}} no point on the vehicle: converted before the converter wrote one, or sent by the game in another frame.
vehicle.hint.regions: CS2: each hit is placed where the shot's ray met the body part the game names. A table converted before that only names the part: the whole part is coloured.
vehicle.layer.killsTitle: Only the hits by the killer in the last seconds before the vehicle died
vehicle.layer.modulesTitle: Destroyed modules, placed where the last hit before each landed
vehicle.colour.label: Colour points and arrows by
vehicle.pick.label: Vehicle
vehicle.counts: {hits, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}}, {placed} on the figure, {fatal} killing
vehicle.sheet.title: Vehicle heatmap - six sides
vehicle.sheet.hint: {n, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}}, every side at the same scale.
vehicle.sheet.sub: {layer}: {n, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}} from {matches, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}}
vehicle.sheet.note: Made with 3DHeat. The figure is the viewer's own, not the game's model.
vehicle.look.title: Look
vehicle.look.exposureHint: 0 fills the ramp at the hottest few per cent of the surface; up shows faint hits, down tells hot spots apart.
vehicle.look.radiusHint: How far a hit's heat spreads over the surface (a Gaussian's radius). Auto is an eightieth of the vehicle, so each hit reads as a spot.
vehicle.look.fitTitle: The game's model has its origin where the game put it; the figure is built round its middle. Moves all of the vehicle's hits by one amount to where they lie best on the figure's surface.
vehicle.look.fitMoved: Hits moved {x} m forward, {y} m up, {z} m right.
vehicle.look.fitOff: Hits as the game sent them.
vehicle.look.arrowsTitle: An arrow for each hit, coming in the way the shot travelled
vehicle.sectors.title: Where the shots came from
vehicle.sectors.hint: By the side of the vehicle each shot came in from, in the vehicle's own frame.
vehicle.regions.title: Body parts hit
vehicle.region.head: Head
vehicle.modules.title: Destroyed modules
vehicle.modules.hint: The game sends a part number, not a name; the same number is the same part of the vehicle.
vehicle.filter.title: Filters
vehicle.hud.kills: {n, plural, one {# killing hit} other {# killing hits}}
vehicle.hud.modules: {n, plural, one {# destroyed module} other {# destroyed modules}}
vehicle.hud.none: No hits pass the filters ({n} before them).
vehicle.look.pointsTitle: Each hit as a mark where it struck, coloured by what it did; click one for its card
vehicle.look.residual: On the figure: median {median} off its surface, {near} % close ({n, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}})
vehicle.look.residualTitle: How far the hits lie from the figure's surface once moved: large where the figure's shape is not the vehicle's.
vehicle.outcome.chipsTitle: Show or hide hits by what they did
vehicle.outcome.killTitle: The hit that killed: the killer's last before the death, or the hurt that left no health
vehicle.outcome.moduleTitle: A module was destroyed right after it (War Thunder)
vehicle.outcome.criticalTitle: The game recorded a critical hit for it (War Thunder)
vehicle.outcome.severeTitle: The game recorded a severe hit for it (War Thunder)
vehicle.outcome.damageTitle: It did damage: it got through
vehicle.outcome.nodamageTitle: It did no damage: it bounced off or did not get through (the replay does not tell the two apart)
vehicle.outcome.hitTitle: A hit; the data does not say what it did
vehicle.stats.title: What the hits did
vehicle.stats.through: {pct} % got through ({n, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}} the data tells)
vehicle.stats.bySide: Share that did no damage, by the side the shot came from:
vehicle.stats.killing: {n, plural, one {# killing shot} other {# killing shots}}: median share of the damage {share} %, {toDeath} s from the killing hits to the death, {modules} modules destroyed by them
vehicle.hud.clickTip: Click a mark for that hit
